Positive/negative residual support signs and the overlap of adjacent windows give the complete independent-set jump equality classification. Pointwise right-continuity and fixed endpoint trace are essential.

value.rationale: The exact identity-defect norm is a natural measure of the discontinuity smoothing cost of the standard quadratic C1 Schoenberg operator. Its universal 13/(24n) versus the C0 linear-spline benchmark 1/(2n) gives an exact 1/12 relative penalty for increased smoothness, and a complete sparsity/spacing classification of worst jump configurations. This is an all-n structural result, not a selected small-grid value; relevance is to jump-aware spline signal approximation, not an asserted broad general theorem.
